blocks.text: Linear regression ek aam statistical model hai jo do variables ka relationship (aapas ka taluq) samajhne ke liye istemal hota hai. Aksar ek variable ki madad se doosre variable ka andaza (prediction) lagaya jata hai. Aayein ek misal se samjhein.

Misal: Socho aap ke shehar mein phal ka chhota stall hai aur aap andaza lagana chahte hain ke roz kitni kamai hogi, is bunyad par ke kitne customers aate hain. Customers ki ginti independent variable (wajah, cause) hai aur kamai dependent variable (asar, effect) hai. Linear regression se hum yeh relationship samjhenge aur aane wali kamai ka andaza lagayenge.
Step 1: Data jama karna
Linear regression model ke liye data chahiye. Farz karein aap ne pichhle 5 din ke customers aur kamai likhi:

blocks.caption: Pichhle 5 din: customers ki ginti aur rozana kamai

blocks.text: Yahan customers ki ginti independent variable (X) aur rozana kamai dependent variable (Y) hai.
Step 2: Linear regression ka formula samajhna
Simple linear regression ka formula:
Yahan:

items: Y dependent variable hai (hamari misal mein rozana kamai),
X independent variable hai (customers ki ginti),
β₀ intercept hai: jab X = 0 ho to Y ki shuruati qeemat,
β₁ slope (dhalaan, line kitni tezi se oopar jati hai) hai: X mein 1 barhe to Y kitna badalta hai,
ε error term hai: predicted (andaze wali) aur actual (asal) qeemat ka farq.

blocks.text: Step 3: Linear regression model banana

Model banate waqt hamara maqsad woh behtareen seedhi line dhoondna hai jo do cheezon ka relationship bataye, yahan customers ki ginti aur rozana kamai. Neeche dekhein slope (40) aur intercept (100) kaise nikalte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan aur heading “Understanding the Intercept” mein intercept β₀ = 300 likhti hai, lekin aage khud hisab kar ke β₀ = 100 nikalti hai. Sahi 100 hai: 500 = β₀ + 40 × 10 se β₀ = 100, aur Earnings = 100 + 40 × Customers paanchon din ke data par poora utarta hai.
Slope samajhna (β₁ = 40)
Slope batata hai ke har naye customer se kitne zyada paise milte hain. Data dekhein:
Dhyan se dekhein: har 5 zyada customers par kamai 200 rupay barhti hai. Is liye ek customer par:
Yani har naya customer kamai mein 40 rupay barha deta hai.
Intercept samajhna (β₀ = 100)

Intercept (β₀) woh kamai hai jab koi customer na aaye. Ise dhoondne ke liye dekhte hain ke line vertical axis (khari line, y-axis) ko kahan kaatti hai, jab customers zero hon. Saada lafzon mein: koi na aaye to bhi base earnings (shuru wali, kam se kam kamai) kitni hai.
Data dobara dekhein:
Is data se slope β₁ = 40 nikla, yani har ek extra customer par kamai 40 rupay barhti hai. Ab intercept ke liye sochna hai ke customers na hon to kitna kamate hain. Yeh equation istemal karein:
Koi bhi data point lein, maslan 10 customers par kamai 500 rupay. Yeh qeematein equation mein rakhein:
Hal karne se:

Matlab data ke hisab se agar koi customer na aaye to bhi taqreeban 100 rupay ki umeed hai, shayad regular (roz aane wale) customers ya kisi aur fixed (pakki) aamdani se. Intercept ke 100 rupay woh kam se kam kamai hai jo zero customers wale din hogi.
Aakhri equation (Final Equation)
Is equation ka matlab:

items: Koi na aaye tab bhi 100 rupay ki kamai hogi.
Har naya customer kul kamai mein 40 rupay jorta hai.

Paanch neele points (10, 500), (15, 700), (20, 900), (25, 1,100), (30, 1,300) ek seedhi line kamai = 100 + 40 x customers par hain. Hara point 22 customers par 980 ka andaza dikhata hai; laal point chhatay din ki asal kamai 1,250 (28 customers) hai, line se zara oopar.

blocks.text: Step 4: Model se nateeja nikalna (Interpreting)
Model ban jane ke baad is se aane wali kamai ka andaza laga sakte hain. Misal: kal 22 customers ki umeed hai to andaza:
Yani 22 customers par taqreeban 980 rupay kamai ki umeed hai.
Step 5: Model ko aazmana (Testing)
Model banane ke baad naye data se aazmana zaroori hai. Farz karein chhatay din 28 customers aaye aur 1,250 rupay kamaye. Model se 28 customers ka andaza:
Lekin asal kamai 1,250 rupay thi. Andaze (predicted) aur asal (actual) kamai ka farq error kehlata hai:

Andaza qareeb tha lekin bilkul theek nahi; asal duniya ke data mein hamesha kuch variation (upar neeche farq) hota hai. Kitab ne error “andaza minus asal” likha hai, is liye minus 30 aaya; matlab model ne 30 rupay kam bataye.
Khud chala kar dekhein
Yeh program model Earnings = intercept + slope × Customers se kamai ka andaza lagata hai aur asal kamai se error nikalta hai. customers, actual_earnings, slope ya intercept badal kar Run karein.

intercept = 100        # beta 0: earnings with zero customers (rupees)
slope = 40             # beta 1: extra rupees per customer
customers = 28
actual_earnings = 1250

predicted = intercept + slope * customers
error = predicted - actual_earnings   # predicted minus actual, as in the book

print("Model: Earnings =", intercept, "+", slope, "x Customers")
print("Customers:", customers)
print("Predicted earnings:", predicted, "rupees")
print("Actual earnings   :", actual_earnings, "rupees")
print("Error             :", error, "rupees")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"intercept = 100": beta 0, yani zero customers par bhi 100 rupees kamai.
"slope = 40": beta 1, har ek customer par 40 rupees izafi kamai.
"customers = 28" aur "actual_earnings = 1250": aaj ke customers aur asal kamai.
"predicted = intercept + slope * customers": model ka andaza = 100 + 40 x 28 = 1220. Python pehle * karta hai, phir +.
"error = predicted - actual_earnings": error = andaza minus asal = 1220 - 1250 = -30. Minus ka matlab hai model ne asal se 30 rupees kam bataya.
Print lines model, customers, andaza, asal kamai aur error dikhati hain.
Output: "Model: Earnings = 100 + 40 x Customers", "Customers: 28", "Predicted earnings: 1220 rupees", "Actual earnings   : 1250 rupees" aur "Error             : -30 rupees".
Khud try karein: customers = 30 kar ke Run karein: andaza 1300 rupees aur error +50 aayega (ab model ne zyada bataya).

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Apna statistical model behtar karne ke liye: 1. Zyada data points istemal karein ta ke accuracy (sahi hone ki had) barhe. 2. Relevant factors (kaam ki wajahein) shamil karein, jaise family size ya khaas mauqe jo kharche par asar dalte hain. 3. Model ko naye data se regularly (baar baar, waqt par) update karein. 4. Apne andazon ko asal kharche se mila kar tareeqa behtar karein.
